notes: Token: src/IMDOLAR.sol, contract IMDOLAR, an OpenZeppelin ERC20 named IMDOLAR with symbol DOLAR and 18 decimals. The constructor mints INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1_000_000_000 * 10^18 = 1000000000000000000000000000 minor units exactly once to msg.sender, which is the factory under launchCustom; token.totalSupply states that figure. The sole constructor argument is address poolManager_, resolved from the $poolManager placeholder to the chain's Uniswap v4 PoolManager and stored as an immutable; the constructor reverts with InvalidPoolManager if it is zero, msg.sender, the token itself, or has no code. The contracts array is empty: the accepted tree holds only the token, with no application contracts and no initialization calls. Tax rule: _update is overridden so every non-zero transfer whose source is the PoolManager, including transferFrom, burns amount - floor(amount / 100) to address(0) and delivers floor(amount / 100). There are no caller or recipient exemptions, no owner, no tax setter, no mint path after the constructor, and no pause, blacklist, freeze, burnFrom or seize function. Burns are the only post-launch supply change and can only shrink it. Launch flows move exactly their stated amounts: the factory's transfer of the swarm's share to the MerkleDistributor, distributor claims, the single-sided seed from the factory into the manager, the remainder forwarded to economics.remainderTo, and a trader's sell into the manager are all sourced from addresses other than the manager and are untaxed. Scope limits, each pinned by a passing test in test/IMDOLAR.v4.t.sol and stated in README.md, copied from its Manifest notes paragraph: DOLAR charges a permanent, immutable 99% tax, burned, on every ERC-20 transfer whose source is the configured PoolManager. This is the only tax mechanism. (1) A v4 swap whose DOLAR output is settled as an ERC-6909 claim or netted inside one unlock is NOT taxed at swap time; the 99% is charged only when DOLAR is withdrawn from the manager as an ERC-20 transfer, and a claim sold back inside the manager is never taxed. (2) EVERY DOLAR outflow from the manager is taxed, including liquidity removal, LP fee collection and protocol fee collection: DOLAR liquidity on this pool is one-way and any LP loses 99% of DOLAR principal on withdrawal. (3) The buyer's share is gross/100 rounded down; outflows under 100 minor units burn entirely. (4) No other venue is taxed and none can be added. (5) The tax is burned; no address receives it. Routers must quote net amounts. Deployment requires the requester's explicit acceptance of these terms. Nothing in the repository evidences that acceptance; it is recorded with the launch by whoever admits it, not here. Closing limits 1 and 2 needs an afterSwap hook on the pool key, which the custom-token launch does not carry, so this token does not supply one. Pool: pairedCurrency is the chain's pair token named by the request, fee 3000 (0.3%), tickSpacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei * 2^192 / totalSupply)) = 127997013751724836065202479, the sqrtPriceX96 with DOLAR as currency0 and the pair token as currency1; if the deployed token address sorts above the pair token the inverse ordering applies, and the deployer derives the actual opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply. economics is the requester's object copied verbatim; the swarm's 1000 bps is taken by the factory and is not written here.
